title: Unity package manifest (fet3d.package/1)
description: manifest.json written by the Unity build worker (BE#110) at the root of its output prefix. The worker registers it twice: as the manifest output (schemaVersion fet3d.package/1, metadata = this document) and as the unity_package output (same objectKey, sha256Hash and sizeBytes). Mobile downloads it with GET /api/training/sessions/{id}/package or GET /api/playtests/{id}/package and checks every file's SHA-256 before Launch.

buildTarget.description: Must equal the job's pinned buildTarget (Android).

minRuntimeVersion.description: Checked against the runtime catalog at playtest/learner start.

revisionId.description: Revision the package was built from (provenance).

lightingScenarios.description: Names of the lighting sets baked into the package (normal and power outage).

metadata.description: Relative path of building_metadata.json (fet3d.building/1); listed in files.

scenario.description: Relative path of scenario.json (fet3d.editor/1 snapshot); listed in files.

bundle.description: Path of the floor scene bundle; must be listed in files.

lightingBundle.description: Path of the outage lighting bundle; must be listed in files.

files.description: Every file of the package except manifest.json, relative to the folder of manifest.json. Paths are unique.

path.description: No '.' or '..' segment, no leading slash.
